description_en: Quickly and accurately detects key fields in a trademark registration certificate, such as the trademark name, registrant, registrant address, validity period, and approved Data Service Project
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别商标注册证中所包含的商标名称、注册人、注册人地址以及有效期限、核定服务项目等关键有效字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-trade-mark-certification --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1SZiGdfb2gK0jSZK9XXaEgFXa-1654-2340.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeTradeMarkCertification

parameters.help_en: Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes; base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB. Use either this parameter or the URL parameter. When using an HTTP request, upload the binary file in the HTTP body. When using the software development kit, place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制文件，最大10MB，与URL二选一。 使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body 中上传即可。 使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
